hero.title: Pick a courier, pay, and follow it to your door.
hero.description: At checkout you see each courier's price and arrival dates for every vendor in your bag. Pay by card, bank transfer, USSD or your Qlozet wallet.

estimate.title: Know when it should arrive
estimate.description: Every product shows its estimated delivery dates, and made-to-measure pieces include the vendor's making time.
points: Delivery dates on the product page
Couriers and arrival dates compared at checkout

tracking.title: Follow every parcel
tracking.description: Each parcel has its own timeline, from booking with the courier to your door, with a tracking code and a link to the courier's site.
points: A notification when it ships, goes out for delivery and arrives

ontime.title: Late from the vendor? You're paid for it
ontime.description: If a vendor ships your order late, we credit compensation to your wallet automatically: 5% of their items for each day late, up to 25%. No need to ask.
points: Credited automatically, every day it's late
Money in your wallet to spend or withdraw
Orders very late are cancelled and refunded in full

problems.title: Report a problem in a few taps
problems.description: Tell us what happened and we open a case with the vendor. Ready-to-wear can be returned within 7 days of delivery, and refunds go to your Qlozet wallet.
points: Damaged, wrong, missing or not as described
Refunds to your wallet, to spend or withdraw

conversion.title: Order with confidence.
conversion.description: Join the waitlist and be among the first to shop on Qlozet.
